# Analysis Practice

This part asks how you show that an analysis was planned in advance
and that the code computes what it claims. It belongs to the second
quarter. The previous part made the analysis rebuildable; this one
makes it defensible, which is a different property: an analysis can
rebuild perfectly and still answer a question nobody specified.

- @sec-analysis-plan states the estimand, writes the statistical
  analysis plan and the data management and sharing plan, and uses
  a Git tag to show that the plan preceded the data.
- @sec-testing writes `tinytest` tests that assert values rather
  than shapes, and runs them on every push with GitHub Actions.

If the quiz at the start of a chapter is easy, skip to the next.
Both chapters are on the one-quarter core path, and the case
studies in Part VII and the capstone assume them.
